name: The Friend-of-a-Friend Intro
objective: Secure a warm intro before the room decides you are all concept and no execution
failure_state: You lose the room, the lead, or the last credible version of your own pitch.
flash_hook: Open on a crowded conference floor with the intro target already walking away and somebody mid-mansplain blocking the lane.
notes: Best when the party is already short on Chill and pretending otherwise.

name: The Manager Escalation
objective: De-escalate a public meltdown before it becomes content
failure_state: You lose the venue, the staff, or the crowd before you lose the argument.
flash_hook: Open at the exact moment someone says 'I need someone who can actually help me.'
